title: My Family
text:
My family lives in a small house. There are four people in my family: my mom, my dad, my brother and me. We have a blue door and a big garden.

Every Sunday, we eat lunch together. My mom cooks soup and bread. After lunch, my dad and I wash the dishes. My brother likes to play football in the garden.

questions.text: How many people are in the family?
What does the family do every Sunday?
How does the writer probably feel about the family's Sundays?
What can we guess about the writer's brother?
options: He likes to be in the garden

vocabulary.definition: a group of people who are related to each other
a piece of land with plants, flowers or grass near a house
with another person or other people
plates, cups and other things we use to eat and drink

paragraph_translations: Моя родина живе в маленькому будинку. У нашій родині чотири людини: мама, тато, брат і я. У нас синіх двері і великий сад.
Кожної неділі ми обідаємо разом. Мама готує суп і хліб. Після обіду тато і я миємо посуд. Мій брат любить грати у футбол у саду.
